name: Viber
description: Rakuten Viber is a messaging and calling platform with commercially approved bots, subscriber messaging, webhooks, channels, and partner-delivered Business Messages.
agentUseSummary: Viber cannot currently be connected as a Relay-owned account integration because its Bot API uses one admin-visible bot authentication token/application key for every request and webhook signature, not delegated OAuth. Bots require commercial approval, subscriber state is not OAuth consent, and Business Messages require a commercial partner relationship.

blocked.label: Connect a Viber account
blocked.description: Viber publishes no delegated account OAuth, callback, scope, refresh-token, or per-installation revocation contract.

blocked.label: Custody a bot application key
blocked.description: The admin-visible authentication token authorizes every bot API request and signs webhook payloads; it is not a connecting user's delegated grant.

blocked.label: Operate a commercial bot
blocked.description: New Viber bots require commercial approval, webhook operations, subscriber/anti-spam controls, and separate terms and billing decisions.

blocked.label: Use Business Messages
blocked.description: Phone-number messaging is available through official commercial partners and is not a self-service Relay account API.

blocked.label: Access Viber data or messaging
blocked.description: Account info, subscriber identifiers, profiles, messages, channels, webhooks, broadcasts, files, payments, and every read/write remain unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported delegated account contract or a separately approved commercial bot/partner product.

runtimeSupport.description: No delegated Viber account contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No delegated Viber account contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Viber uses a commercially approved bot's admin-owned application key, a single webhook, and subscriber opt-in rather than delegated account OAuth; Business Messages require an official partner relationship.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Viber credentials or show Connect. Reconsider after Viber publishes a distributable delegated account contract, or through a separate commercial bot/partner product decision covering terms, billing, spam, abuse, webhook ownership, and token rotation.

evidence.supports: Viber documents commercial bot approval, one admin-visible authentication token in X-Viber-Auth-Token, one webhook, HMAC callback signatures using that same secret, and subscriber opt-in.
Viber documents non-expiring bot application keys, support-assisted replacement, commercial bot terms, and partner-delivered Business Messages rather than OAuth.
Viber defines the authentication token/application key as the bot's secret identifier visible to bot administrators.
